task_title: OBSDB-003: embedding request outcomes by provider plus cache hit/miss counters
task_criteria: After a semantic recall, GET /metrics on a scratch daemon renders at least one duckbrain_embedding_requests_total{provider,outcome=ok} series, and the counters are incremented at the real provider embed call (search/rebuild/recall path), not only by the /health probe.

A provider that accepts a connection and never answers makes duckbrain_embedding_requests_total{outcome=timeout} increase, and the falsifier holds: with providers.ts and cache.ts reverted to the pre-fix tree the new instrumentation tests fail (7 failed / 3 passed) instead of passing.

duckbrain_embedding_cache_hits_total over (hits + misses) is defined after two identical queries (hits > 0 and misses > 0), counted at EmbeddingCache.get, and the labels stay bounded: provider is a registry id or unknown, outcome is ok|timeout|auth|quota|error, never a model id, host, path or error string.

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ After a semantic recall, GET /metrics on a scratch daemon renders at least one duckbrain_embedding_requests_total{provider,outcome=ok} series, and the counters are incremented at the real provider embed call (search/rebuild/recall path), not only by the /health probe.: Instrumentation sits at the real provider call: src/embedding/providers.ts:400-412 `trackEmbedRequest` wraps the embed and calls recordEmbedSuccess/recordEmbedFailure, applied at the two product construction points (createProvider + auto-probe branch) and deliberately NOT to the health probe. src/http/metrics.ts:465 `registerEmbeddingMetrics(registry)` attaches the process-wide counters to the app registry so they render on GET /metrics. Test src/http/metrics-obsdb003.test.ts:378-430 spins a real createHttpServer on an ephemeral port, runs real semanticSearch, then does an HTTP GET /metrics and asserts /^duckbrain_embedding_requests_total\{provider="lmstudio",outcome="ok"\} \d+$/m with value > 0. Command: `npx vitest run src/http/metrics-obsdb003.test.ts` -> exit_code 0, 'Tests 10 passed (10)'. Broader run `npx vitest run src/embedding src/http` -> exit_code 0, 'Test Files 74 passed (74) / Tests 628 passed (628)'.
  ✓ A provider that accepts a connection and never answers makes duckbrain_embedding_requests_total{outcome=timeout} increase, and the falsifier holds: with providers.ts and cache.ts reverted to the pre-fix tree the new instrumentation tests fail (7 failed / 3 passed) instead of passing.: Test src/http/metrics-obsdb003.test.ts:245 'records timeout when the provider accepts and never answers (the falsifier)' sets fake.mode="hang" with a 60ms budget, asserts sampleValue(...,'provider="lmstudio",outcome="timeout"') === 1 and outcome="ok" === null. Falsifier reproduced live: `git checkout 781a3ba3^ -- src/embedding/providers.ts src/embedding/cache.ts` then `npx vitest run src/http/metrics-obsdb003.test.ts` -> 'Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)' — exactly the specified 7/3 split, with the failure at metrics-obsdb003.test.ts:423 (no duckbrain_embedding_requests_total series rendered). Files restored (git diff HEAD empty for both) and re-run -> 'Tests 24 passed (24)' across metrics-obsdb003.test.ts + metrics.test.ts.
  ✓ duckbrain_embedding_cache_hits_total over (hits + misses) is defined after two identical queries (hits > 0 and misses > 0), counted at EmbeddingCache.get, and the labels stay bounded: provider is a registry id or unknown, outcome is ok|timeout|auth|quota|error, never a model id, host, path or error string.: Counted at the single cache-residency decision: src/embedding/cache.ts:120-137 `EmbeddingCache.get` calls recordEmbeddingCacheHit() on bin and legacy hits and recordEmbeddingCacheMiss() on miss/corrupt; metrics.ts:194-207 define the counters. Test src/http/metrics-obsdb003.test.ts:333 runs two identical queries and asserts hits === 3, misses === 3, ratio hits/(hits+misses) === 0.5 and Number.isFinite(ratio) === true. Label boundedness: metrics.ts:57 EMBED_OUTCOMES is the fixed 5-value enum ['ok','timeout','auth','quota','error'] and recordEmbedRequest (metrics.ts:166-180) coerces any out-of-enum value to 'error'; embeddingProviderLabel (metrics.ts:125-131) keeps only the registry prefix and returns 'unknown' otherwise. Tests at :173-221 assert all 11 internal failure classes collapse into the enum (never 'ok'), that 'lmstudio/text-embedding-qwen3' -> 'lmstudio', 'http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1' -> 'unknown', and that rendered output matches /qwen|text-embedding-test|127\.0\.0\.1/ nowhere. All 10 tests in the file pass (exit_code 0).
All three OBSDB-003 criteria are met: embedding request outcomes are counted at the real provider embed call and rendered on a live daemon's /metrics, the hang-provider timeout case increments outcome=timeout, the falsifier reproduces exactly 7 failed / 3 passed on the pre-fix tree, and cache hits/misses are counted at EmbeddingCache.get with strictly bounded provider/outcome labels.
